senses.definition: n.pr.m. ( = יְבָרֶכְיָהוּ s. Yah blesseth Ges§ 27, 3) father of a Zechariah in Isaiah’s time Is 8:2; usually in abbreviated form as foll.: בֶּרֶכְיָה,
son of Zerubbabel 1 Ch 3:20.
a Levite guard of the ark 1 Ch 9:16; 15:23.
father of Meshullam, one of Nehemiah’s chiefs Ne 3:4, 30; 6:18.
father of the prophet Zechariah Zc 1:1 = בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ v 7; בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ also
father of Asaph 1 Ch 6:24; 15:17.
Ephraimite chief 2 Ch 28:12.
